method: Manual obligation-level assessment under unchanged pre-dispatch Query/Style criteria and separate navigation criteria; cross-checked with frozen registered data and independent compare-selected probes. Replay checks integrity, not answer semantics.

query-stop-1.assessment: Both unrun command argv arrays match the requested literal/framework and preferred dependency/depth/target scenarios. Literal preservation, ordinal matching, repeat collapse, UTF-16 limit and astral rejection, closed depth values and 1/all neighbors, direct-inclusive versus legacy semantics, and candidate/row bounds agree with registered rules. No unstated package-ID normalization or executed package result is asserted. Complete installed facet data is distinguished from live package availability and completion/failure caveats.

navigation-baseline-1.assessment: Starting literal closure lacks dependency depth and target rules. The agent follows the emitted CLI-binding href and its advertised facet hrefs, obtains the preferred exact dependency/depth/target command, rejects 1/all, and preserves unexecuted-result uncertainty. All later requests use previously returned hrefs verbatim, with no search or constructed path.
navigation-baseline-1.trace: The binding advertises ordinary application/json resource links without projection=hal. Subsequent facet responses are compact ordinary explain resources, not explicit schema contracts, although the participant calls them full contracts. This boundary demonstrates necessary navigation across the advertised graph; it does not demonstrate remaining in HAL throughout.
